structure: Opening: the café is about to have a hectic few minutes.
Staff side: the barista's overflowing cup; the 'cash only' sign vs. the customer holding a card.
Customers: the last pastry; the laptop and the coffee on the edge of the table.
Big finish: the group of five arriving vs. one free table for two, with hedged options.
modelAnswer: I have a feeling this café is in for a pretty hectic few minutes. First, the barista is pouring milk while she's turned away chatting, and the cup's already overflowing, so she'll have a mess to clean up and have to remake the drink. At the register, a customer is holding out her card, but a sign says the card machine is down and it's cash only. Since she doesn't seem to have any cash, she'll either have to run to an ATM or ask to pay next time. Behind her, a man is pointing at the pastry case, where there's only one pastry left, so somebody's bound to be disappointed. A man at a table is stretching his arms, and his coffee is sitting right on the edge of the table, so one careless move and it'll be all over his laptop. Finally, a group of five is about to walk in, but there's only one free table for two, so they'll probably either squeeze in, get their drinks to go, or head somewhere else.

usefulExpressions.expression: …is in for a pretty hectic few minutes
usefulExpressions.usageVi: Sắp phải trải qua vài phút bận rộn — 'be in for' = sắp gặp (điều khó khăn)
Vì có vẻ cô ấy không… — suy luận có rào đón
Cô ấy sẽ hoặc… hoặc… — đưa ra hai khả năng
Chắc chắn sẽ thất vọng — dự đoán chắc chắn
Chỉ một động tác bất cẩn là… — cấu trúc nói tự nhiên, nhấn mạnh nguy cơ
Họ có lẽ sẽ… — liệt kê các khả năng ở phần kết

commonMistakes: Kết luận chắc chắn điều tranh không cho thấy ('she has no money'); dùng 'she doesn't seem to have any cash on her'.
Thiếu cấu trúc 'either… or…' song song: 'either she runs to an ATM or pay later' → 'she'll either run to an ATM or pay later'.
Không quản lý thời gian 60 giây: nên chọn 4–5 dự đoán chính, không cố nói hết mọi chi tiết.
